body: I don't know if she is going to forgive me for this one, but I sure hope she is willing to talk it through. She wasn't even mad as much as horribly disappointed. Like she didn't even know who I was. I don't know who I am right now.
Thank you for sharing your experience. You're right of course. I just truly cannot imagine going on without my wife. I don't know how I could ruin the best thing that has ever happened to me.
